"""Repair unit/prefix projections for traffic masses and arbitrary masks."""
import numpy as np
from typing import Optional
from array_utils.cpu.types import cpu_cast_float

def project_onto_probability_simplex(x: np.ndarray, pinned: Optional[np.ndarray] = None, mass=None, active=None) -> np.ndarray:
    """
    Given a 2D array `x`, project each column onto ``{w >= 0, sum w = mass}``
    (unit mass by default).  ``pinned`` hides entries at or beyond the given row
    index, ``active`` is an explicit boolean mask of the entries allowed to carry
    traffic and ``mass`` gives the demanded total per column.  Hidden entries are
    returned as exact zeros and never enter the support.
    """
    x = np.array(x, dtype=float, copy=True)
    N, M = x.shape
    if mass is None:
        mass = np.ones(M)
    else:
        mass = np.array(np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(mass, dtype=float), (M,)), dtype=float)
    keep = np.ones((N, M), dtype=bool)
    if active is not None:
        keep &= np.asarray(active, dtype=bool)
    if pinned is not None:
        keep &= np.arange(N)[:, np.newaxis] < np.asarray(pinned, dtype=int)[np.newaxis, :]
    hidden = np.where(keep, x, -np.inf)
    usable = keep.any(axis=0) & (mass > 0.0)
    u = np.sort(hidden, axis=0)[::-1]
    cssv = np.cumsum(u, axis=0)
    rank = np.repeat(np.arange(1, N + 1, dtype=float)[:, np.newaxis], M, axis=1)
    condition = (u * rank) > (cssv - mass)[np.newaxis, :]
    rho = np.sum(condition, axis=0) - 1
    rho = np.where(usable, np.clip(rho, 0, N - 1), 0)
    theta = (cssv[rho, np.arange(M)] - mass) / cpu_cast_float(rho + 1.0)
    w = np.clip(hidden - theta, a_min=0.0, a_max=None)
    w = np.where(np.isfinite(w), w, 0.0)
    w = np.where(keep, w, 0.0)
    w[:, ~usable] = 0.0
    return w


def project_onto_probability_orthant(x: np.ndarray, pinned: Optional[np.ndarray] = None, mass=None, active=None) -> np.ndarray:
    """
    Project onto the volume of the probability simplex: columns already inside
    stay put (clipped at zero), the remaining ones are pushed onto the surface.
    """
    x = np.array(x, dtype=float, copy=True)
    N, M = x.shape
    if mass is None:
        mass = np.ones(M)
    else:
        mass = np.array(np.broadcast_to(np.asarray(mass, dtype=float), (M,)), dtype=float)
    keep = np.ones((N, M), dtype=bool)
    if active is not None:
        keep &= np.asarray(active, dtype=bool)
    if pinned is not None:
        keep &= np.arange(N)[:, np.newaxis] < np.asarray(pinned, dtype=int)[np.newaxis, :]
    x = np.where(keep, x, 0.0)
    totals = x.sum(axis=0)
    columns = np.flatnonzero((totals > mass) & (mass > 0.0))
    if columns.size == 0:
        return np.clip(x, 0.0, None)
    block = x[:, columns]
    x[:, columns] = project_onto_probability_simplex(
        block, None, mass[columns], keep[:, columns])
    return np.clip(x, 0.0, None)
